criteria.reason: Snapshot gives both argument forms, both slug rules and the .trd-state/task-<slug>/ directory.
Snapshot names the clash sources and the -2, -3 suffix.
Snapshot defines no-feature-in-flight and the two values written.
Snapshot leaves current.json alone when a feature is in flight and reports it in the readout.
Read-back after the save shows every listed key, trd_file null and kind task.
The brief-form read-back holds the brief path; the prompt-form read-back holds brief: null.
checkpoint(s,1,{}) read back as commit: null.
Deferred step stored with its reason and retry_count 0; task.md Step 2 states run-once and never retry.

task.md Rules (lines 52-53) direct honouring verification.md's environment permissions and resource capacity (simulator pools, memory floors) and the repo's shared-machine rules, and forbid pkill. Snapshot is byte-identical to the shipped task.md.
artifacts.json holds report, report-2 and report-3 after three records.
get --kind report returned the URL recorded with --url; publishing is conditional on ensemble.publishArtifacts.
The directory, the escaping path and the absolute path were each rejected; artifacts.json was unchanged afterwards.
Step 4's closed.json template carries all nine keys: feature task-<slug>, trd null, closedAt, closedBy task, note null, audit null, reason, outputs, followups.
Step 4 states reason is task-complete when at least one step ended success and task-stuck when none did.
Each followup in the template carries summary and evidence; the Rules and the must-not list forbid acting on followups or filing them as issues.
The file gives the Readout section, then the Completion signal: notify-complete.sh "task" with task-<slug> in the summary, then PushNotification, then 'Only after that' the current.json clean-up.
Completion signal clears current.json's four keys only if its status still points at this task's implement.json, otherwise leaves it alone.

The COMPLETE banner '═══ COMMAND COMPLETE: /task ═══' is the last line; zero completed steps ends COMMAND STUCK; some success plus some deferred ends COMMAND COMPLETE, and Step 4 writes closed.json in both cases.

Judged directly (no first-stage check for this criterion). The prompt-form and brief-form fixtures were each built with the real implement-state.js and artifacts.js. Each holds steps marked success or deferred, a report entry, and a closed.json with outputs and followups, and the files agree with each other.
Resume scans .trd-state/*/implement.json for the most recent kind task file with no closed.json beside it, and states it never needs current.json.
Resume continues from the first step whose status is neither success nor deferred; a failed step is recorded deferred and never re-run, so deferred steps are not re-run.
